classification: Repository-only original-source provenance/population anchor; never install the synthetic transport ConfigMap as admission policy.
localPolicies: GitOps, edge/identity and workloads maps distinguish ordinary actual Kubernetes resource rules (with native v1/ConfigMap CEL parameters where required) from genuine cross-object/source/provenance joins. Admission-suitable rules are candidates only; no live deployment or enforcement is claimed.
nativeAPI: Pinned Kyverno1.19.0 Test has top-level policies/resources/paramResources/results. Exact outcomes use resources: [] and resourceSpecs {group,version,kind,namespace,name}; there is no singular resource or top-level result namespace field. CEL params and Test.paramResources were inspected in the pinned handler/CLI source before use.
boundary: Python enumerates originals, transports raw evaluated facts into native parameter resources, materializes checked-in Tests/resources, and checks independent outcome identities/skip/error coverage. It does not compute resource-policy verdicts. No selector/JSON-pointer mutation language, runtime suite generation or mirrored bundle JSON remains; cross-object counterfactuals use checked-in standard yq filters.
inputs: Canonical plus twelve genuine root extendModules identity/Seerr/ingress combinations; actual production Den resolver/instantiate pipeline is unchanged. Every original file/document and duplicate identity is preserved, with actual bootstrap provenance and only required evaluated option leaves. Anchor has one raw bundle map. Ordinary resources are supplied directly to native local rules.
schema: The existing pinned prod-home-manifests-schema runner and prod-home-kubernetes-schemas corpus validate every actual variant before serialization and again for caller-supplied immutable inputs. Variant CRD definitions must equal the immutable flake canonical manifests used to derive the corpus, not a writable caller-provided canonical copy. Schema counterexamples remove the trusted-only PreserveOrGenerate enum while direct mode remains valid, and reject a malformed real normal-phase provisioning Job.
coverage: scenario-inventory.json independently declares required native scenario and exact expected-result identities as compact, auditable tuples with named columns. Runtime discovery must match it exactly; deleted/unknown Tests, deleted negative outcomes, changed phase selections, missing rules/policies/resources/Values, skips, selector misses, evaluation errors and empty native reports cannot silently pass. Intentional fail-closed counterfactuals explicitly require rejection and the intended diagnostic, not a native semantic pass.
counterfactuals: Copy immutable policy inputs as writable files; change an actual variant manifest or native policy/Test/Values, then run the pinned runner. Source schemas are revalidated and raw anchors are re-enumerated from current original manifests, never a stale prior bundle. Use separate report directories. Native checked-in fixture resources and yq filters provide targeted counterexamples without production state changes.
legacyDeletion: No legacy validator/check removed. Family maps give symbol-level deletion ownership; parent must obtain native parity/counterfactual evidence and authorize deletion and CI registration.
verification: Workers ran no builds, Nix evaluations, tests, linters, formatters or smokes. Parent reported all twelve root render derivations built, followed by an individual-helper sibling-path failure before CLI; helper now preserves the whole source directory context. These are not policy pass claims. Parent executes the resulting native gate.
